name: jobiba-career
description: Find jobs, research salaries, tailor your CV to each job, apply with confirmation, prepare interviews and track applications; employers can post jobs, screen applicants, shortlist and contact candidates, all from chat. Powered by live Jobiba data.

interface.shortDescription: Jobs, salary research, tailored CVs and hiring tools from Jobiba.
interface.longDescription: Connect AI agents to Jobiba for interactive job discovery, full salary research (percentiles, trend, skill premiums, offer analysis), company research, saved jobs and alerts, evidence-based matching, resume and application workflows, interview prep, and employer services: dashboard, job posts, applicant pipeline, AI talent search and secure plan upgrades.
defaultPrompt: Find relevant Jobiba jobs and show interactive job cards.
Search jobs by role, location, work mode, experience and salary currency/pay period.
Open this vacancy in chat and check how my experience matches it.
Build and tailor my Jobiba resume for this job.
Prepare my application and explain what is missing before I apply.
Track and improve my Jobiba applications.
Analyze my skill gaps and create an interview plan.
Post this vacancy to my Jobiba employer account.
Research salaries for this role and check my offer.
Show reviews and interview difficulty for this company.
Show my employer dashboard and applicants.
Show plans and what upgrading unlocks.
Tailor my CV to this job and show the changes before applying.
Check how strong my profile is and upgrade it from chat.
Screen my applicants and shortlist the best candidates.
